title: Acquire a complex return from four local reference powers
statement: For I_theta=|h+R exp(i theta)|^2/2 at four quadratures,R>0,opposite differences divided by2R recover h. Simultaneous absolute power errors eta give field error<=sqrt(2)eta/R. Three target states cost twelve scalar powers.

requires: Known bounded positive reference amplitude and acquired quadrature/commonality bounds
provides: Complex field with explicit absolute error from scalar detector readings
assumptions: Power-normalized passive reciprocal ports and calibrated three target loads;no free calibration on an uninstrumented hidden target.
Local reference is isolated from the specimen;unshared drift and preparation/numerical errors enter the actual bound.
No laboratory operation,code replay,photon superiority or historical priority follows from these proofs.
costs: Charge all raw powers,reference/signal photons,combiner loss,calibration,mask writes,load switching,settling and reset;no free parameter,clock or arbitrarily strong local oscillator.
contract.units: Dimensionless power per incident feed-power unit;field amplitude is its square root. r,z,s are complex reflection amplitudes;R is reference amplitude. Physical photon/time calibration remains an acquired input.
contract.obstruction: Extra interference information changes the intensity-only interface;it supplies no free phase stability or photon advantage.
